Won Spring 2020.|Inventory Description}} {{QuoteBox|OH NO THE BEES!|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Swarmer''' is an event damage over time [[Towers|tower]] that could have been obtained by triumphing [[Eggy Island]]'s Hard difficulty as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It could have also been bought via a gamepass for {{Robux|350}} during Spring 2020, and can most recently be bought again for {{Robux|799}}. The '''Swarmer''' deals damage by throwing beehives and later by firing bees, additionally applying a single stack of bees on an enemy. The struck enemy is then inflicted with the ''Bee Debuff'' effect, taking damage over time without requiring the '''Swarmer''' to directly attack it. The bee stack has a set duration for each level, in which it will then decay with the individual ''Bee Debuff'' effect expiring along with it. The enemy will be damaged each ''Tick'', the interval between each sting for a given amount of time, known as ''Sting Time''. This functions similarly to other forms of tick damage, such as the [[Pyromancer]]'s burn damage. The '''Swarmer''' can apply multiple bee stacks at a single enemy, with each '''Swarmer''' having a cap that increases every level. Other '''Swarmers''' can contribute to the stack, exceeding the initial maximum stack in an instance where there is only one '''Swarmer''', and multiple bee stacks will inflict all of their collective DPS on a single target. When there are multiple stacks applied, ''Sting Time'' does not apply to each one. Instead, after the first stack's ''Sting Time'' ends, a single stack will be removed and the timer will restart. The ''Bee Debuff'' effect will persist so long as there is at least one extant stack. There is a limit of 10,000 stacks per enemy. This can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies and bypasses [[Defense]]. The '''Swarmer''' additionally has the ''Bee Swarm Grenade'' (internally just ''Swarm'') ability, where it throws a grenade that deals AOE damage and applies a single stack of bees to all enemies caught in the explosion radius. The ''Bee Debuff's'' stats from ''Bee Swarm Grenade'' is directly proportional to the current level of the '''Swarmer''' that it was thrown from. The bee swarm grenade's explosion deals explosion damage, bypassing defense, dealing damage to [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] while also having no damage drop off. Due to its stacking capabilities, the '''Swarmer''' is generally considered to be a boss killer, being able to do quite high DPS when a lot of ''Bee Debuff'' effects are stacked. Additionally, it also has decent early game potential. It, however, is heavily hindered by its lack of detections and generally not being that strong with a low amount of extant bee stacks. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Extra }} ==Strategy== *The '''Swarmer''' is generally not the most effective option for earlier parts of the game due to its slow firerate, rather low range and low sting damage. **If used, it should be set to ''Strongest'' so that it can hit as many enemies as possible or prioritize stronger enemies to apply more bee debuff effects to. ''First Enemy'' targeting would make it always target the first enemy, which can be ineffective as some damage will be wasted if you have more than enough stacks. ***Later on, as '''Swarmer''' excels in single target damage, it is best to keep all '''Swarmers''' placed on ''Strongest''. **It can, however, become a very strong tower once higher health enemies such as the [[Fallen Squire]] and [[Slow Boss]] start to appear. *The '''Swarmer''' will reapply the bee debuff effect to an enemy if it attacks the same enemy, allowing it to be stacked. **Only the sting time for one effect can be active on an enemy. If there are 100 stacks, the earliest one will be active. This effectively means that constantly applying the effect can extend it. **This allows it to reach extremely high DPS values, even being able to take down the bosses like the [[Fallen King]] and [[Molten Warlord]] somewhat quickly. For example, ten Level 5 '''Swarmers''', after firing at a boss for just 12 seconds, will have applied roughly 100 stacks of bees, dealing a total of 400 DPS from just the incomplete stack alone. *The [[Commander]] can be extremely useful with the '''Swarmer''', as it allows it to apply its effects at a faster rate, making its rampup much faster. **The [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost it, however its effects are far less effective on it due to the [[Damage Buff]] only buffing its main attack (which has its damage revoked at Level 3) and ''Bee Swarm Grenade'', so it is recommended to use Purple track instead if the '''Swarmer''' is your only or primary DPS source. ***The Green track can additionally help with affording the extreme amount of '''Swarmers''' required to reach the tower's full potential. *The ''Bee Swarm Grenade'' ability can be used to quickly apply the stinging effect to multiple enemies, allowing the '''Swarmer''' to start dealing more damage faster. **If multiple '''Swarmers''' are placed down, using abilities from multiple of them can allow you to mass apply the effect to multiple enemies at once. Additionally, as only one effect can expire at once, it will last for quite a while before it ends. *The '''Swarmer''' is unaffected by some debuffs applied by enemies, but not all. For example, [[Wox the Fox]] will be unable to apply the [[Scared Debuff]] to it, but the [[Boomer]] can apply all its debuffs without any issues. ==Trivia== *The original design of '''Swarmer''' is based on ''R2DA's'' [[w:c:r2da:Swarmer|Swarmer]] in name and appearance. **Additionally, the '''Swarmer's''' Level 5 outfit was very similar to R2DA's [[w:c:r2da:Beekeeper Suit|Beekeeper Suit]]. *The store description is taken from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vhOgYN5SDQg a scene] involving Nicholas Cage in the film ''The Wicker Man''. *Immediately after the '''Swarmer's''' addition, it could have been bought for {{Coins|2,500}}. **However, this was soon removed, and anyone who acquired the '''Swarmer''' this way was refunded. *The '''Swarmer's''' stinging mechanic was originally a bug that allowed the '''Swarmer''' to stack the effect multiple times. This would be removed in [[v1.9.0]] with the tower debuff reworks, though later brought back in [[v1.52.0]]. *The '''Swarmer''' has the highest cost efficiency in the entire game, at {{Money|3,808.63}} on Level 5. *The '''Swarmer''' is currently the only tower to have one of its upgrades remove its direct damage. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page.'' {{Scroll|text = *'''6 April 2020''' -
